answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 37127 Country: India Title: I have chosen my son's name as REHAAN HASSAN. I want to know whether this name is correct. And what is the meaning of this name Question: I have chosen my son's name as REHAAN HASSAN. I want to know whether this name is correct. And what is the meaning of this name? It is not Raihan, it is Rehaan. I have to make the birth certificate. Is the combination is correct one. He was born on 23rd October. Is the name something to do with his prosperity and luck. He is very hot tempered for this please suggest something, he even harms his body. Doctor says it is natural for male child, but please suggest some amal or tavez for this. Please reply as early as possible. Answer ID: 37127 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 488/277/H=1433) (1) It is correct. It means: fragrant, aromatic. (2) It is a fact that good names have good effects. Write this name in birth certificate. Whatever the doctor says it is also right. (3) See number 2 for the same. (4) Recite the following dua 3 times with durood 3-3 times before and after and blow it on the child and blow it on water and give it to the child to drink. رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماً Also do the same in the night before sleeping. Also write this ayah on paper and hang it in the neck of the child. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
